What is CrewAI and how does it work?

CrewAI is an open source Agent Management Platform (AMP) that helps you build, orchestrate, and scale AI agents. These agents can plan, reason, use tools, and collaborate to complete complex tasks. With CrewAI, you can design workflows visually through a no-code editor or take full control with code. Once deployed, agents connect seamlessly with your apps, systems, and data—making it easy to automate processes, improve efficiency, and unlock new possibilities.

How do I deploy a CrewAI Template?

We have a step-by-step guide on how to deploy CrewAI Templates on our Enterprise platform.

How do I customize a CrewAI Template?

You can download the template code and modify it locally, commit the changes to your GitHub repository, select the repo from your CrewAI dashboard, add environment variables, and hit deploy.

(function() {
  
  // ============================================
  // CONFIGURATION - Customize these settings
  // ============================================
  
  const CONFIG = {
    // Error message text
    errorMessages: {
      invalid: 'Please enter a valid email address',
      freeEmail: 'Please use a business email address',
      required: 'Business email is required'
    },
    
    // Error styling
    errorStyle: {
      color: '#ff0000',
      fontSize: '14px',
      marginTop: '5px',
      fontWeight: 'normal'
    },
    
    // Input error styling
    inputErrorStyle: {
      borderColor: '#ff0000',
      borderWidth: '1px',
      borderStyle: 'solid'
    },
    
    // Submit button disabled styling
    submitDisabledStyle: {
      opacity: '0.5',
      cursor: 'not-allowed',
      pointerEvents: 'none'
    },
    
    // Show real-time validation (true) or only on submit (false)
    realtimeValidation: true,
    
    // Validate on blur (when user clicks away from field)
    validateOnBlur: true
  };

  // List of free email domains to block
  const freeEmailDomains = [
    // Major providers
    'gmail.com', 'yahoo.com', 'hotmail.com', 'outlook.com',
    'aol.com', 'icloud.com', 'mail.com', 'protonmail.com',
    
    // International variants
    'googlemail.com', 'yahoo.co.uk', 'yahoo.ca', 'yahoo.in',
    'yahoo.com.au', 'hotmail.co.uk', 'hotmail.fr', 'outlook.co.uk',
    
    // Other popular free providers
    'yandex.com', 'yandex.ru', 'zoho.com', 'gmx.com', 'gmx.de',
    'inbox.com', 'live.com', 'msn.com', 'me.com', 'mac.com',
    
    // Privacy-focused
    'proton.me', 'tutanota.com', 'pm.me', 'tutamail.com',
    
    // Other free services
    'fastmail.com', 'hushmail.com', 'mail.ru', 'web.de',
    'qq.com', '163.com', '126.com', 'sina.com', 'rediffmail.com'
  ];

  // ============================================
  // VALIDATION FUNCTIONS
  // ============================================

  function isFreeEmail(email) {
    if (!email || !email.includes('@')) return true;
    const domain = email.split('@')[1].toLowerCase();
    return freeEmailDomains.includes(domain);
  }

  function isValidEmailFormat(email) {
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    return emailRegex.test(email);
  }

  // ============================================
  // UI FUNCTIONS
  // ============================================

  function showError(input, message) {
    removeError(input);
    
    const errorDiv = document.createElement('div');
    errorDiv.className = 'business-email-error';
    
    // Apply error styling
    Object.assign(errorDiv.style, CONFIG.errorStyle);
    errorDiv.textContent = message;
    
    // Insert error after input
    input.parentNode.insertBefore(errorDiv, input.nextSibling);
    
    // Apply error styling to input
    Object.assign(input.style, CONFIG.inputErrorStyle);
  }

  function removeError(input) {
    const errorDiv = input.parentNode.querySelector('.business-email-error');
    if (errorDiv) {
      errorDiv.remove();
    }
    
    // Reset input styling
    input.style.borderColor = '';
    input.style.borderWidth = '';
    input.style.borderStyle = '';
  }

  function toggleSubmitButton(form, disable) {
    if (!form) return;
    
    // Find submit button (input or button type)
    const submitBtn = form.querySelector('input[type="submit"], button[type="submit"], .pop-up-submit-button');
    
    if (submitBtn) {
      submitBtn.disabled = disable;
      
      if (disable) {
        Object.assign(submitBtn.style, CONFIG.submitDisabledStyle);
        submitBtn.setAttribute('data-business-email-disabled', 'true');
      } else {
        // Reset to original styling
        submitBtn.style.opacity = '';
        submitBtn.style.cursor = '';
        submitBtn.style.pointerEvents = '';
        submitBtn.removeAttribute('data-business-email-disabled');
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // VALIDATION LOGIC
  // ============================================

  function validateBusinessEmail(input, showErrors = true) {
    const email = input.value.trim();
    const form = input.closest('form');
    
    // Empty field
    if (!email) {
      if (showErrors) {
        removeError(input);
      }
      toggleSubmitButton(form, true);
      return false;
    }
    
    // Invalid email format
    if (!isValidEmailFormat(email)) {
      if (showErrors) {
        showError(input, CONFIG.errorMessages.invalid);
      }
      toggleSubmitButton(form, true);
      return false;
    }
    
    // Free email check
    if (isFreeEmail(email)) {
      if (showErrors) {
        showError(input, CONFIG.errorMessages.freeEmail);
      }
      toggleSubmitButton(form, true);
      return false;
    }
    
    // Valid business email
    removeError(input);
    toggleSubmitButton(form, false);
    return true;
  }

  // ============================================
  // EVENT HANDLERS
  // ============================================

  function setupInputValidation(input) {
    const form = input.closest('form');
    
    // Disable submit initially if empty
    if (!input.value.trim()) {
      toggleSubmitButton(form, true);
    } else {
      // Validate existing value
      validateBusinessEmail(input, false);
    }
    
    // Real-time validation on input
    if (CONFIG.realtimeValidation) {
      input.addEventListener('input', function() {
        validateBusinessEmail(this, true);
      });
    }
    
    // Validation on blur
    if (CONFIG.validateOnBlur) {
      input.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        if (this.value.trim()) {
          validateBusinessEmail(this, true);
        }
      });
    }
    
    // Prevent form submission if invalid
    if (form && !form.hasAttribute('data-business-email-validation')) {
      form.setAttribute('data-business-email-validation', 'true');
      
      form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        const businessEmailInputs = this.querySelectorAll('.busienss-email-field, .business-email-field');
        let allValid = true;
        
        businessEmailInputs.forEach(inp => {
          if (!validateBusinessEmail(inp, true)) {
            allValid = false;
          }
        });
        
        if (!allValid) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          return false;
        }
      }, true); // Use capture phase to ensure this runs first
    }
  }

  // ============================================
  // INITIALIZATION
  // ============================================

  function initializeValidation() {
    // Find all business email inputs (supporting both spellings of the class)
    const businessEmailInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.busienss-email-field, .business-email-field');
    
    businessEmailInputs.forEach(input => {
      // Check if already initialized
      if (!input.hasAttribute('data-business-email-initialized')) {
        input.setAttribute('data-business-email-initialized', 'true');
        setupInputValidation(input);
      }
    });
  }

  // Initialize on DOM ready
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeValidation);
  } else {
    initializeValidation();
  }

  // Watch for dynamically added forms
  const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
    let shouldInit = false;
    mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
      if (mutation.addedNodes.length) {
        mutation.addedNodes.forEach(function(node) {
          if (node.nodeType === 1) { // Element node
            if (node.matches('.busienss-email-field, .business-email-field') ||
                node.querySelector('.busienss-email-field, .business-email-field')) {
              shouldInit = true;
            }
          }
        });
      }
    });
    if (shouldInit) {
      initializeValidation();
    }
  });

  observer.observe(document.body, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });

  // Expose validation function globally if needed
  window.validateBusinessEmail = validateBusinessEmail;

})();

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const form = document.getElementById("request-a-demo-form");
  if (!form) return;

  form.setAttribute("data-hs-ignore", "true");
  form.classList.add("hs-form-ignored");

  const portalId = "45732688";
  const formId   = "3a8a3651-588a-436d-943b-376bee2efb8b";

  form.addEventListener("submit", async function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const data = new FormData(form);
    const btn = form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
    const originalText = btn?.textContent || "Submit";
    
    if (btn) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = "Submitting...";
    }

    const hutk = document.cookie
      .split("; ")
      .find(r => r.startsWith("hubspotutk="))
      ?.split("=")[1];

    const payload = {
      fields: [
        { objectTypeId: "0-1", name: "email",     value: data.get("email")     || "" },
        { objectTypeId: "0-1", name: "firstname", value: data.get("firstname") || "" },
        { objectTypeId: "0-1", name: "lastname",  value: data.get("lastname")  || "" },
        { objectTypeId: "0-1", name: "jobtitle",  value: data.get("jobtitle")  || "" },
        { objectTypeId: "0-1", name: "company",   value: data.get("name")      || "" }
      ],
      context: {
        pageUri: window.location.href,
        pageName: document.title,
        ...(hutk && { hutk })
      }
    };

    const endpoint = `https://api.hsforms.com/submissions/v3/integration/submit/${portalId}/${formId}`;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(await res.text());

      form.reset();
      form.style.display = "none";
      document.getElementById("request-a-demo-success-message")
        ?.style.setProperty("display","block","important");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("HubSpot submission error:", err);
      alert("Error submitting the form. Please try again.");
      
      // Restore button on error
      if (btn) {
        btn.textContent = originalText;
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    } finally {
      // Only disable if successful (handled above for errors)
      if (btn && !btn.disabled) {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    }
  });
});
</script>
